title: New Wave of Attacks on Strait of Hormuz Threatens Regional Oil Price Recovery
detail: A new wave of attacks targeting shipping in the Strait of Hormuz is threatening the region's fragile oil price recovery, according to Australian strategic analysis. The escalation compounds risks to food and energy supply chains transiting the strait, with analysts warning that sustained disruptions could reverse recent stabilization in global commodity markets.

title: Iran's Top Security Official Warns of Dire Economic Crisis as Rial Collapses Under Sanctions and War Costs
detail: Iran's top security official issued a stark warning about the country's worsening economic crisis, as the rial came under severe pressure from a combination of international sanctions and the mounting costs of ongoing military engagements. The currency collapse is deepening food insecurity domestically and reducing Iran's capacity to sustain operations in the Strait of Hormuz region.
